name: Super Natural Dorm
detailed_description:
Kirsa, a young girl who has just graduated from school, has been sent by her mother to her uncle, whom she has not seen for a long time and loves very much.

But by random circumstances it’s revealed to her that her uncle, who has grown old and became addicted to beer, rents out rooms not to humans, but to a variety of supernatural beings who live under the same roof and try to blend into human society.

The world that the young girl was going to explore turned out to be not quite as simple as she thought, and now she has to find out what her uncle forgot and what her new housemates are hiding.

  • The visual novel will feature a linear plot structure, unfolding over 21 game days, starting from day one. Players will have the freedom to explore the character arcs in any order they choose. Each of the six character arcs—Cassandra, Miquel, Raymond and Ariana, Berislava, Oliver, and Viktor—will be divided into three parts. Simultaneously, players will follow the main storyline, where they will help Kirsa unravel the mystery surrounding her uncle. 

  • Despite the linear progression, players will have the option to choose from four romantic interests: Cassandra, Miquel, Raymond, or Berislava. This choice is made at the end of the first day, with the option to choose none as well. Once a romantic partner is selected, choices during their corresponding character arc will influence the story, offering different situations and outcomes. Making the “right” choices will unlock extra scenes, accessible from the main menu. Upon completing all 21 days, a special "event" will appear before the final conclusion. 

  • There will be one definitive ending. Yes. Only one. Rather than offering multiple outcomes, the game will focus on delivering a well-developed plot with rich, fully fleshed-out characters.

Kirsa Bermer 

Species: Human 

Personality: Thoughtful, sociable, caring, inquisitive, impatient

Orientation: Bisexual

Species: Human

Personality: Grumpy, lazy, pessimistic, caring, selfless

Species: Werewolf (Feline Werewolf) 

Personality: Strong and independent, assertive, purposeful, vindictive, flirtatious

Orientation: Bisexual

Miquel Delamare

Species: Vampire

Personality: Calculating, prudent, pragmatic, meticulous

Orientation: Heterosexual

Oliver Berglund 

Species: Dwarf 

Personality: Friendly, life of the party, refined, sociable

Orientation: Asexual

Berislava Vila

Species: Siren 

Personality: Cheerful, creative, stubborn, friendly, flighty 

Orientation: Homosexual

Raymond and Ariana Felicitas 

Species: Fallen Angel (Raymond) and Ghost (Ariana) 

Personality: 

Raymond: Calm, caring, attentive, awkward, friendly

Ariana: Sensitive, active, cheerful, mischievous 

Orientation: Raymond – Omnisexual

Viktor Velikovsky

Species: Human, Magician 

Personality: Arrogant, confident, responsible, proud, scrupulous 

Orientation: Heterosexual

Erna Aizemann 

Species: Human 

Personality: Strict, decent, quick-tempered, responsible, reasonable 

Orientation: Heterosexual
